01

Letter from the organization

No single discipline can contain the work.

Mathim Divisions began as a name for an organization that could do anything. It was invented by two friends long before its projects were real. The name survived because the premise remained useful.

Today it provides a common home for independent research, technical practice, writing, and whatever comes next. Different projects, shared curiosity, no requirement to look alike.

Affiliated initiative / Research file 001

The Smol Model Company of New Haven

An independent research lab investigating useful model capability under practical limits: compute, memory, bandwidth, latency, power, data, and cost. Research is reported with experiments, evidence, and limitations intact.
